DATABASE.scope: All legacy database domains DB00–DB10 plus complete source semantic reconciliation, normalized persisted models, migration replay and verified constraints
requiredGates: Every active historical data concept/field classified and mapped or explicitly justified as retired
All approved DB structures are registered; clean PostgreSQL migration replay and snapshot drift checks succeed
Tenant, authorization, FK, deletion, uniqueness, audit/history, state-machine and concurrency database invariants are proven with executed tests
No active DB migration, privacy, missing-table/field or cross-domain consistency blocker remains
Reconcile DB00–DB10 source inventories against fresh legacy oracles and sign off global DB gate

API.scope: All LMS API and service operations for every role/domain, including state transitions, permission/error/side effects and cross-role workflows
requiredGates: Global legacy API/service/UI-initiated user-job inventory completed across every role and domain
Each required operation mapped to tested vNext API/service or approved redesign/retirement
Authorization, tenant, input, error, concurrency and side-effect contracts pass executed integration tests
Full producer-to-consumer domain and cross-role workflows pass
No open required API/service parity rows remain

UI.scope: All seven account + shared/public route/section/action/modal/state/mobile/accessibility clone parity
requiredGates: Global route/navigation/section/action/modal inventory reconciled to frozen legacy FE/BE SHAs
Master and detailed page parity counters have zero required unresolved rows
Seven-account and shared cross-role browser regression suites pass
Clone parity gate reports READY YES on current main

RELEASE.scope: Full system integration, infrastructure, security, adversarial audit and production launch
requiredGates: Full CI and migration/test suite green on target release commit
Live Identity Platform/Cloud SQL/GCS/outbound/provider integration and smoke validated
Production launch and post-launch verification accepted

globalHistoricalInventorySnapshot.warning: Source candidates not necessarily active; 0 verified does not mean 0 implemented.

transitionRule: A future active chat may promote DATABASE→API→UI→RELEASE only after independently verifying ALL phase gate requirements with exact commit/test evidence, all required queue items DONE_VERIFIED or approved retirement, and no blocking dependencies. CAS-update phase-state and activate eligible next-phase queue items. No worker changes phase alone.
